jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. ### **About the Role** This role has two core parts, both centered around working closely with the best AI labs in the world. First, you’ll partner directly with our lab customers to integrate their models, run and deliver evals, and act as their go\-to person at Arena Intelligence. You’ll plug into their research roadmap, understand where they’re headed, and help them get real value from our data. Along the way, you’ll spot gaps, surface new opportunities, and help shape what we build next. Second, you’ll roll up your sleeves and build. You’ll take on specific customer engineering asks and ship solutions that push the frontier of what our platform can do. Some of what you build may eventually scale into our Data or Applied ML stack — but it starts with solving real, high\-impact problems for cutting\-edge AI teams. ### **You’ll** * Own 5–15 active model lab relationships as the day\-to\-day point of contact * Partner directly with researchers and product teams to integrate models, run evals, and deliver high\-quality results * Drive consistent delivery across onboarding, data \+ product releases, co\-launches, and unblock unexpected issues fast * Be the “owner” of a key process improvement or automation (e.g., model onboarding flow, customer data insights, delivery tooling) * Translate customer feedback and research direction into concrete product ideas and engineering work * Work across the stack to ship pragmatic solutions that push the frontier for our customers * Help expand strategic accounts through trust, execution, and sharp technical judgment ### **You’ll have** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) * Production experience in **TypeScript** and modern web frameworks * Hands\-on experience integrating LLM provider APIs, including streaming responses * Comfort moving across frontend and backend — you’re willing to dig in wherever the problem is * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows * Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to operate in ambiguity * Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain complex technical ideas to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * A customer\-first mindset and a genuine desire to work closely with multiple stakeholders **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Architectural Intern
jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Architectural Intern to join our architecture and engineering team. This is a paid internship providing an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience working on real\-world residential and commercial projects from initial design through construction documentation and permitting. The intern will work closely with experienced architects and engineers and will be exposed to architectural design, drafting, 3D modeling, construction documents, structural details, and building code requirements. This position is ideal for a student or recent graduate looking to develop practical skills and gain valuable experience in a professional architecture and engineering environment. **Responsibilities** * Assist with preparation and development of architectural and structural drawings. * Produce and modify drawings using AutoCAD and/or Revit. * Assist with architectural layouts, floor plans, elevations, sections, and construction details. * Assist with preparation of structural details and construction documentation. * Develop 3D models and presentations using SketchUp, Rhino, or similar software. * Assist with research and application of applicable building codes and zoning requirements. * Assist with preparation of permit and plan\-check submittal documents. * Coordinate drawings and information between architectural and engineering disciplines. * Organize project files, drawings, and supporting documentation. * Participate in project development and gain exposure to the overall design and permitting process. **Qualifications \& Experience** * Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Architecture, Architectural Engineering, Civil/Structural Engineering, or a related field. * Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit. * Familiarity with SketchUp, Rhino 3D, or other 3D modeling software is highly desirable. * Experience with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus. * Basic understanding of architectural drawings, construction documents, and building systems. * Familiarity with building codes, zoning regulations, or construction processes is a plus. * Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain organized project files. * Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with a multidisciplinary team. * Strong communication, problem\-solving, and time\-management skills. * Willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities. We are looking for someone who is motivated to learn, takes pride in their work, and wants to build a strong foundation for a career in architecture and engineering. This is a paid internship with opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility based on performance and experience. Pay: $18\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 24\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Creative Video Producer
jobs.description: Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in\-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows. We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms. Reducto has raised over $108M from world\-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital. **The Opportunity** ------------------- As Reducto’s **first in\-house Video Producer**, you’ll define how we tell stories through video: from creative product launches and customer stories to developer content and behind\-the\-scenes looks at our team. This is a rare opportunity to build Reducto’s video function from the ground up. You’ll have the freedom to shape our video strategy, develop original series, and experiment with new formats, but you’ll also be the person behind the camera and in the edit. You’ll own the entire creative process, from the first idea and shot list through filming, editing, and publishing. You’ll sit on the marketing team and work closely with our founders, engineers, sales team, customers, and the rest of the company. The right person combines the instincts of a storyteller with the resourcefulness of a hands\-on producer and is excited to make technical ideas feel clear, creative, and worth watching. **This is an on\-site role based in our San Francisco Office.** **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own video from concept through final cut, including ideation, scripting, pre\-production, filming, lighting, sound, editing, and delivery. * Develop repeatable video series and original formats that highlight our people, culture, product, customers, and perspective on AI. Experiment often, learn from what resonates, and help establish a distinctive visual and editorial voice for Reducto. + Concept and produce creative product launches that make technical capabilities compelling and memorable. + Create customer stories and case\-study videos, working directly with customers to capture what they have built with Reducto. + Partner with engineering and developer relations to produce technical explainers, demos, interviews, and educational content for developers. + Capture life at Reducto through employee profiles, founder content, office moments, off\-sites, conferences, and industry events. * Turn each production into content for multiple channels, creating thoughtful edits for YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Tiktok, and paid campaigns. * Can create motion graphics, animation, or other visual elements that make product stories easier to understand. * You are excited about AI and eager to experiment with emerging tools for animation, asset generation, editing, and production, while bringing the creative judgment to know when they genuinely improve the work. * Work closely with the broader marketing team to connect video to launches, campaigns, social content, events, and company priorities. * Build the systems behind a high\-output video function, from production workflows and equipment recommendations to asset organization and external support. **You’ll Thrive Here If You** ----------------------------- * Have a **strong portfolio of work you personally produced, filmed, and edited**. Your application should clearly explain your role in each featured project. * Hold yourself to a high bar for quality and craft, with strong attention to the details that make a video feel polished—from framing and sound to pacing, design, and the final edit. * Are deeply curious about AI and technology, but also interested in how to highlight the human stories behind it. * Have excellent storytelling instincts and know how to find a strong narrative in a product, a person, or an everyday company moment. * Can direct people who are not professional on\-camera talent and help them feel natural, confident, and interesting. * Take full ownership. You won’t wait for someone else to turn an idea into a brief, schedule the shoot, or finish the edit. We aren’t optimizing for a particular number of years of experience. We’re looking for evidence that you can recognize a strong story, make it real, and carry it across the finish line yourself. **Bonus Points If You** ----------------------- * Have worked as the sole or first video hire at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup. * Come from a multidisciplinary creative background spanning video, photography, design, journalism, writing, or social content. * Have experience in media, including YouTube, digital publications, newsrooms, documentary production, or creator\-led channels. * Have produced content for technical, developer, or B2B audiences. * Have experience filming customer interviews, events, conferences, or documentary\-style stories. * Have built or grown a social or YouTube channel and understand how format, pacing, packaging, and distribution affect performance. **Why Reducto** --------------- * **Impact:** You’ll establish a new creative function and shape how the world understands Reducto, our customers, and our team. * **Ownership:** You’ll have the freedom to develop original ideas and the responsibility to bring them to life. * **Access:** You’ll work directly with founders, engineers, customers, and teams building at the frontier of AI. * **Speed:** We move fast, ship often, and iterate in days, not months. * **Learning:** Work alongside world\-class engineers, operators, and founders who care deeply about product, precision, and velocity. This is an in\-person role based in our San Francisco office. We’re an early\-stage company, we move fast and work hard. Please apply only if that excites you. **Equal Opportunity** Reducto is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other protected category. Compensation Range: $130K \- $160K

jobs.title: Director, ASIC Verification
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are seeking a Director of ASIC Verification who leads from the front: you'll own verification strategy, sign\-off, and the team — and you'll also be one of the strongest hands\-on verification engineers here, writing testbenches, closing coverage, and debugging the hardest failures. This role will be performed onsite from our office in Santa Clara, CA. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * Own verification end\-to\-end: strategy, methodology (UVM, formal, emulation, coverage\-driven closure), tape\-out sign\-off for Netpreme silicon, IP, subsystems and post silicon bringup support including test\-vector generation. * Architect and author verification environments and testplans, review testbench code line\-by\-line, and personally drive debug of the hardest protocol, coverage, and bring\-up issues * Recruit, lead, and develop a world\-class verification organization that treats technical depth as the currency * Present verification readiness, metrics, and risk posture to engineering leadership with conviction **Qualifications** * BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. * 8\+ years of progressive ASIC/SOC verification, with 5\+ years leading verification teams * Demonstrable experience writing verification code, building testbenches, and closing coverage * Multiple tapeouts in advanced process nodes where you owned both deep technical work and sign\-off * Hands\-on experience with high\-speed protocol IP — Ethernet, UCIe, UALink, or comparable * Fluent across the full ASIC/SOC lifecycle — microarchitecture through tape\-out — on designs integrating interconnect, I/O, and memory subsystems * Executive communication skills; proven ability to manage risk, escalations, budget, and headcount on startup timelines **Preferred Qualifications** * PhD in EE, CE, or related field * Built a verification team from zero at an early\-stage startup while delivering milestones personally * Hands\-on post\-silicon bring\-up, debug, and validation leadership * AI/datacenter accelerator background; familiarity with LLM memory/dataloader bottlenecks * Knowledge of DFT and its interaction with front\-end verification **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive salary with performance\-based bonus and early\-stage equity grant * 100% employer\-paid Health, Dental, and Vision coverage for you and your dependents * 401(k) match with immediate vesting, and access to financial advisors to help you reach your financial goals * 100% employer\-paid Life, Disability, and AD\&D insurance, plus a fitness stipend and wellness \& mental health perks * Generous PTO: 20 vacation days, 15 company holidays (including 3 floating days of your choosing) * Daily lunch stipend * Enterprise\-level Claude \& ChatGPT access with a generous token budget * Well\-equipped, sunny offices in Santa Clara, CA \& Cambridge, MA with on\-site parking and EV charging; on\-site fitness center in Santa Clara; gym discounts near our Cambridge office * Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance to one of our office hubs * A collaborative, continuous\-learning environment with smart, dedicated colleagues building the next generation of high\-performance computing architecture **The Opportunity** * **Impact:** Humanity stands at the dawn of a new industrial revolution driven by AI—one with the potential to redefine how we live on this planet. We are tackling a fundamental challenge at the infrastructure layer: unlocking greater AI capability while dramatically improving efficiency. The work we do here compounds across state\-of\-the\-art AI models, systems, and real\-world applications. * **Timing:** Breakthrough technology matters most when it meets the right time. Joining now means real ownership of the company and meaningful influence over product direction and execution. In this early\-stage environment, your ideas shape the trajectory of the technology—not just its implementation. You’ll work from first principles, move quickly from insight to execution, and see your contributions directly reflected in what we build. * **Culture:** You’ll work alongside a group of people who care deeply about rigor, clarity, and impact. We value thoughtful disagreement, fast learning, and intellectual fearlessness. This is a place where strong ideas shine, curiosity is encouraged, and growth is a daily practice—not a future promise.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Docflow builds AI agents that run the back office for healthcare providers. Our automation handles the work that buries their teams: document intake, prior authorizations, order entry, and payer portal workflows. Customers start with a paid pilot, see real work getting done within weeks, and expand from there. We're a small, scrappy, AI\-native founding team, and we're growing fast. Every customer we sign runs live workflows that have to keep working, and there are more of them every month. That's why we're hiring you. The Role This is an engineering role that lives where the product meets the customer. You'll stand up new customer workflows alongside our sales team, keep the live ones healthy, and own the systems that make both of those faster every month. Here's how we work, and it's the most important thing to understand about this job: **we do the work manually first, then we automate it.** When a workflow needs fixing, you fix it. Then you ask the real question, which is how to make that fix faster next time, or unnecessary, or something the customer can do for themselves. We expect you to keep scaling yourself, handling more and more by building systems behind you. The person who does well here is constitutionally incapable of doing the same manual thing twice without trying to automate it. You'll also own our QA product. An agent reviews production runs against each workflow's requirements and flags the ones that fall short. You'll review its verdicts, accept or reject what it files, and then make the agent better at its job. That loop is this role in miniature: do the judgment work yourself, then teach the system to do more of it. To be clear about what this isn't: it's not a support queue in the help desk sense, it's not a pre\-sales demo role, and it's not a consultant embedded at a customer site. You'll write and review real code every week, from our office, with the rest of the team. What You'll Do * Build out new customer workflows with the account executive who owns the account. They stay in the lead and bring you what the customer needs; you make it real. We want this as close to real time as possible, and making it faster is part of your job, not a nice\-to\-have * Support live customer workflows: fix what breaks, then remove the reason it broke * Own our QA product, from reviewing what the agent flags to making the agent sharper * Own how workflow changes get published: make sure deployments do what they're supposed to, catch the changes that shouldn't ship, and roll back cleanly when something is wrong * Watch for patterns. A workflow that keeps needing the same fix is telling you something upstream is wrong, and chasing that down is worth more than closing the ticket * Build the tooling, checks, and guardrails that make everything above take less time every month * Learn our customers' industry well enough to argue with how they describe their own process What We're Looking For **Must have:** * Real professional software engineering experience. You'll write and review production code every week, and defend the business logic you wrote. * Strong TypeScript, or strong experience in a comparable typed language plus the appetite to get to strong TypeScript quickly. * The ability to read unfamiliar code fast. Much of what you touch was written by someone else, or by an agent. * An instinct to automate your own work. This is the single most important trait for this role. Doing the manual version first is the job; leaving it manual is not. * Genuine interest in complicated real\-world processes. Prior authorization rules, billing codes, payer\-by\-payer exceptions that exist for reasons nobody ever wrote down. If a twenty\-step workflow that nobody has documented sounds tedious rather than interesting, this will be a frustrating job. * A customer\-centered instinct. The account executive owns the customer relationship and stays in the lead, so you won't be on every call. But every judgment call you make comes down to what this looks like to the person whose order it is. * Comfort in a company of four to six people, where the job is whatever it takes and you'll largely define your own benchmarks as you go. * Willingness to work in\-office five days a week, and to be around some evenings and weekends when something critical breaks. **Preferred:** * Forward deployed, solutions, implementation, or product engineering experience where you also wrote production code * Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, insurance, or another domain with dense rules you had to learn from scratch * Experience with durable workflow orchestration, browser automation, or long\-running job systems * You use AI coding tools yourself, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, to move faster * Based in Los Angeles, or ready to be We'll teach you the industry. We can't teach you to find it interesting. Compensation and Benefits * Base salary of $150,000 to $185,000 depending on experience * Founding\-team equity * Health insurance Compensation Range: $150K \- $185K

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description: Docflow builds AI agents that run the back office for healthcare providers. Our automation handles the work that buries their teams: document intake, prior authorizations, order entry, and payer portal workflows. Customers start with a paid pilot, see real work getting done within weeks, and expand from there. We're a small, scrappy, AI\-native founding team, and we're growing fast. We ship a lot of real software fast, and we hold a high bar for how it's built. That's why we're hiring you. The Role You'll be an early engineer working directly with our CTO on the core product: the systems that ingest documents, orchestrate long\-running automated workflows, drive browser automation across dozens of external portals, and present it all in a fast, modern web app. This is a true full\-stack role. You'll move fluidly from the database to the backend and workflow engine to the UI. We're hiring two engineers. This is the one that builds the platform itself, including the engine every customer workflow runs on and the pipeline they ship changes through. Disney Media Systems Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware, and software\-based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer\- facing linear and digital video/audio content. Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post\-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more. The Media Systems Engineer II position is the perfect role for an engineer who has some hands\-on sustainment and design/build experience with the creation, production, and distribution of linear or digital video/audio content. Media Systems Engineer II’s are primarily focused on the sustainability of our existing technology. They are the start of a tiered sustainment model where incidents are escalated from a shared operations team (tier 1\) to the Media Systems Engineer II’s (tier 2\) and beyond. Additionally, while Media Systems Engineer II’s are learning the nuances of Disney’s technology and learning to apply their own education and engineering experience, they may be asked to work on some system integration projects; documentation and preventative engineering. Media Systems Engineer II’s use their experience to solve increasingly complicated issues without much support for more senior engineers and can easily perform integration tasks with little direction. **Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:** * Architect, design, source, and construct media technology environments that allow DEET Technology the ability to acquire, produce, store, stream, distribute our content. * Resolve issues that affect production, broadcast, and content distribution across multiple DEET networks including system outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems, and conduct diagnostic testing, repair, and replacement activities necessary to solve routine, specialized, and complex problems. * Analyze and troubleshoot streaming audio/video signals in traditional SDI and IP 2110 essence flow routing environments. * Analyze and troubleshoot cloud platforms as necessary. * Manage third\-party service providers by enforcing the agreed upon scope of services within the various signed service agreements (i.e., full ti pates in complex engineering projects at the direction of more experienced engineers. * Reviews, maintains, and contributes to system/workflow documentation. * Participates in training and development objectives. Motivated and inventive, always finds a way forward—eternal optimist with a committed drive for contributing and making a difference. * Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives. **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** **Minimum Qualifications:** * 3\-4 years years of demonstrated and relevant experience in leading others ensuring efficient design/build, uptime, and overall stability of the technical environments of live media production and distribution. * Proficient in SMPTE standards for broadcast television and video production/streaming environments. With a current certification such as not limited to ST 292M, ST 424M, ST 2110, ST 2059, IEE1588, ST 2022\-7, SCTE\-104, etc. * Knowledge and experience with on\-prem and cloud\-based storage and compute infrastructure platforms and current technological offerings. asset management systems, file\-based workflows, media acquisition, transcoding/encoding, graphics, and NAS/SAN technologies. * Knowledge and experience with coordinated receiver decoders IRDs, core devices, edge devices, timing of video and audio systems, audio, and video media file formats are a plus. * Ability to create, read and interpret AutoCAD and other technical drawing/documentation scalers, playback systems, etc. + Studio technology includes video walls, cameras, VR set technology, image processing systems, touch screens, lighting, etc. + File\-based workflows like enterprise jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Biostatistics
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote available (U.S. Only) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- ResearchScience Research **Compensation** ---------------- * $180K – $250K • Offers Equity **About us** ============ Edison Scientific builds and deploys AI scientist agents to accelerate science and the development of new medicines. We are an ambitious team run by scientists and engineers from leading institutions across biology, physics, chemistry, and AI. **Role** As a **Forward\-Deployed** **Biostatistics Subject Matter Expert**, you will build and evaluate AI agent systems to automate statistical analysis and clinical development workflows. You'll be embedded directly with some of the world's leading pharma and biotech organizations, and will be responsible for ensuring Edison's AI agents deliver statistically sound, regulator\-ready outputs. You'll work with our partners to create benchmarks that measure agent performance on complex tasks across trial design, SAP development, and submission\-quality statistical deliverables, then work with our internal AI engineering team to improve agent performance on those tasks. You'll need to deeply understand our partners' statistical methodology, their study design conventions, and their regulatory bar, then determine where our platform can drive the most meaningful impact. This position would ideally be in Boston, NYC or San Francisco, but we are also open to fully remote with 20\-40% travel. **Responsibilities** * Improving the ability of LLM agents to execute long, coherent statistical analysis and trial design tasks within real\-world scientific environments and customer data infrastructures. * Designing benchmarks to evaluate LLM agent performance, acceptance criteria, and failure modes on complex biostatistical tasks (e.g., SAP development, sample size determination, endpoint analysis). * Partnering directly with biostatisticians and clinical development leaders at client organizations to apply AI agents to statistical and regulatory deliverables. * Serving as the statistical authority on AI\-generated outputs, evaluating accuracy and regulatory soundness, identifying failure modes, and determining what warrants further investigation. * Partner with GTM and account executives to scope engagements, define success metrics, and support pre\-sales technical evaluation. * Build trusted relationships with biostatisticians and research leaders at customers, earning credibility as both a statistical peer and a knowledgeable AI practitioner. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of experience in biostatistical applications within biotech or pharma (sponsor or CRO). * Graduate degree (Ph.D. preferred) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related discipline. * Proven expertise in crafting SAPs, determining sample sizes, and designing early\-phase (I/II) clinical trials. * Proficiency in R and/or SAS (both preferred). * Experience in therapeutic areas such as oncology, immuno\-oncology, immunology, cardiovascular, neurology, or hepatology (MASH) preferred. * Deep familiarity with ICH and FDA regulatory standards, including direct experience with CSRs, IND filings, and CDISC\-compliant datasets (SDTM/ADaM). * Prior experience in an industry or client\-facing context, outside of academia. * Ability to travel domestically 20\-40% of the time. **Bonus points for** * Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript. * You enjoy quickly iterating on ideas through rapid prototyping. * You operate with high independence, and like to execute complex tasks to completion in a high\-stakes environment. * You thrive when working on a diversity of projects in sprint\-based formats, and have high comfort with uncertainty. * You are proficient in statistical programming and validation, and could QC or independently reproduce an analysis if necessary. **Why join us?** ================ We're a fast\-moving, mission\-driven culture where smart people do their best work and actually enjoy doing it. We also offer full\-time employees the following: * Competitive salary and equity * Full healthcare coverage; we pay 100% of premiums for you and your dependents * Support for growing families, including a yearly new parent stipend and fertility coverage through Carrot * Mental health support through Rula, our in\-network therapist and psychiatrist network with fast availability * 12 weeks of paid parental leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption * Pet care support with a yearly employer\-funded stipend for your animal companions * Commuter benefits so you can pay for transit and parking with pre\-tax dollars * 401(k) company matching * $300 health and wellness benefit quarterly * Lunch is on us every day you're in the office, and dinner is on us when you're working late * Regular team off\-sites and company events *Edison Scientific is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

The Technical Support role requires a team\-oriented demeanor that can receive unresolved technical issues escalated from sales and/or service departments, impart troubleshooting guidance toward resolution and translate escalated issues into corrective actions with principals and/or internal training needs. **Essential Functions:** * Assist sales to design and develop specifications and drawings, equipment selections and material/labor cost estimates for strategic and custom projects including industrial, petro\-chemical, combined heat and power and power steam systems. * Review/prepare sales estimates and/or drawing and proposal packages that are for design engineers use or out to bid and prepare material, labor and misc. material estimates along with any exceptions/clarifications to our proposal in comparison to the job bid documents. * Assist sales process with Technical and/or Project Management customer presentations. * Sales assistance and project support will require travel and overnight stays as needed. * Prepare mechanical, electrical, piping and control drawings with AutoCAD and some Solid Works as needed in response to successful bid. * Prepare submittal packages including catalogue cut sheets for all items used on the packaged assemblies. * Review approved submittals and make all corrections as noted to conform the package system to the job/reviewed submittal requirements. * Develop and/or supervise development of construction drawings as needed! * Assist with the construction of the system as needed to maintain schedule, budget, and design integrity. * Develop “as\-built” documentation and drawings including Operation and Maintenance Manuals * Provide after\-shipment support as needed for successful system commissioning. * Develop and maintain key mechanical contractor relationships with respective contractor service/project critical contacts. * Serve as the senior Technical Support resource supporting escalated field troubleshooting efforts. * Serve as Technical representative, alongside other RFM site representation, to liaise with principals regarding product problem resolution and/or product improvements. Requirements: * Excellent Customer Service skills and knowledge. * Proficient in communications both verbal and written. * Interpersonal Skills * Safety Focus * Critical Thinking/Evaluation * Reasoning skills * Ethical conduct \& practices * Time Management * Personal Effectiveness/Credibility * Flexibility * Timeliness * Initiative * Change Agent * Microsoft Project and Visio proficiency * Aggressive hands\-on designer and problem solver * AutoCAD proficiency * Reading and understanding electrical, process flow and mechanical drawings. * Experience in boiler and pumping systems, piping design and layout, process and flow diagrams, electrical control, industrial steam, and power systems design * Experience in construction * Requires managing schedules, project budgeting and reporting to meet specific project requirements. * Verbal and written communication competence with team members, suppliers, and customers * Good computer, time management and communication skills * Good customer/vendor interaction and communication skills are needed to assist with proposals presentation and run projects to completion. * Strong networking and relationship building skills with other RFM sites, principals and associated key product suppliers. * Strong technical troubleshooting skills and ability to impart resolution guidance to others. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within a consistently changing environment. **Supervisory Responsibility** This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities. **Work Environment** This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This is largely a deskbound role; however, filing, correlating, reproduction and binding materials are required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets, bend or stand on a stool, climb stairs, and prepare training and meeting rooms/spaces as necessary. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, listen, bend, squat, walk, lift, pull, push, and climb stairs. **Position Type/Expected Hours of Work** This is a full\-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. This position regularly requires long hours and occasional travel work as job duties demand. **Travel** Travel may be required for this position to customer and RFMCo. sites with out\-of\-area and possible overnight travel expected. **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in ME, or related discipline preferred or Associate degree and 4 – 7 years of relevant project management experience; or 7 years of relevant project management experience. * 5 years’ experience in project management/estimating. * Ability to perform diversified clerical functions and working knowledge of GAAP and accounting procedures. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills**.** * Proficient in Excel, Word, and accounting software systems.) * Strong interpersonal skills. * Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions. * Ability to deal effectively with a diversity of individuals at all organizational levels. * Commitment to excellence and high standards. * Strong organizational skills; able to manage priorities and workflow. * Keystrokes a minimum of 45 wpm. * Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm. * Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language(s) used in the workplace. * Professional appearance and demeanor * Excellent attendance and promptness a must. **Preferred Education and Experience** Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferred. **Other duties:** Please note, this job description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Robotics Software Engineer** **Full\-time \| Sunnyvale, CA \| Engineering (Onsite)** ### **About Noble Machines** Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission\-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real\-world problems, we'd love to talk. ### **Position Overview** As a Robotics Software Engineer, you will work closely with senior engineers to bring hardware prototypes to life and build essential software tools that support our robotic platforms. In this hands\-on role, you will assist in integrating new hardware components, developing diagnostic and control interfaces, and maintaining ROS 2 nodes. If you enjoy working with physical systems, writing practical C\+\+ and Python code, and building usable tools across hardware\-software boundaries, this role offers an exciting opportunity to grow your technical skills on real\-world systems. ### **Responsibilities** * Integrate new hardware prototypes with the robot’s software systems. * Rapidly develop proof\-of\-concept software for evaluating new components and designs. * Build control, configuration, visualization, and diagnostic GUIs for engineers and operators. * Create reusable tools for hardware bring\-up, testing, calibration, data collection, and troubleshooting. * Develop and maintain ROS 2 nodes, interfaces, drivers, and supporting applications. * Work with hardware engineers to define software interfaces and translate prototype requirements into working systems. * Test integrated hardware/software behavior, analyze logs and telemetry, and diagnose issues across subsystem boundaries. * Improve successful prototypes into reliable, documented, and maintainable engineering tools. * Contribute to automated testing, simulation, deployment infrastructure, and other robotics software projects as priorities require. * Participate in design discussions, code reviews, documentation, and field or lab testing. ### **Requirements** * 0–2 years of experience in robotics software, embedded systems, or hands\-on engineering projects. * Practical C\+\+ and Python ability. * Software fundamentals and debugging skills. * Comfort working with physical systems and imperfect prototypes. * Some ROS or robotics project experience, without requiring deep ROS 2/DDS expertise. * Familiarity with common communication interfaces or protocols—such as CAN, serial, Ethernet, or USB—if those match the hardware. * Ability to build simple user\-facing tools or GUIs. * A bias toward experimentation, iteration, and completing usable prototypes. * Clear communication with engineers from different disciplines. ### **Nice to Have** * Hands\-on experience with hardware bring\-up, microcontroller development, or sensor integration. * Familiarity with simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) or containerization (Docker). * Educational background or degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. * Open\-source contributions or personal robotics projects. ### **California Pay Transparency Statement** Pay Transparency \& Compensation: In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Act (SB 1162\), the expected base salary range for this position located in Sunnyvale, CA is $90,000 – $130,000 per year. Mason Way Half Day, paid Jury Duty, and paid Bereavement Leave * Paid Parental Leave * Paid company holidays * Career Development Program * Retirement and Financial Wellness program * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Alternative/Hybrid Work Schedules **General Description** The Senior AI Engineer will design, build, and deploy secure, domain\-specific AI solutions for industrial operations, including agentic applications, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), machine learning services, and workflow co\-pilots. This role translates complex manufacturing and engineering requirements into practical, supportable products that connect operational data with modern AI capabilities across edge, cloud, and hybrid environments. **Specific Responsibilities** * Lead the design and delivery of production\-grade AI applications, including LLM agents, RAG systems, workflow co\-pilots, and predictive or optimization services. * Translate manufacturing workflows, operating constraints, and user needs into well\-scoped technical solutions in partnership with operations, engineering, OT, IT, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders. * Design agent architectures using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, including supervisor\-worker patterns, REST or Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces, governed tools, and appropriate human approval points. * Develop enterprise retrieval solutions using embeddings, vector stores, semantic search, knowledge graphs, and structured operational content such as SOPs, logs, maintenance records, and engineering documentation. * Use contemporary AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, supported by evaluation datasets, test harnesses, guardrails, monitoring, and independent review of model behavior, generated code, and agent recommendations. * Design agent\-ready data products that route requests appropriately across live edge data, hot time\-series stores, and historical lakehouse data. * Integrate AI solutions with industrial and enterprise platforms, including OPC UA, MQTT/Sparkplug B, Unified Namespace architectures, SCADA/DCS data, Power BI, SharePoint, and custom applications. * Partner with data engineering teams on schema\-versioned data contracts, contextualization, validation, and streaming integrations across Azure Event Hubs, Azure Data Explorer, Databricks/Delta Lake, and ADLS Gen2\. * Package and operate solutions as secure, containerized services for cloud, edge, on\-premises, or regulated deployment environments; contribute to CI/CD, observability, and operational support. * Frame ambiguous industrial problems, evaluate alternative approaches, and advance promising concepts from rapid prototype to maintainable production capability. * Document architecture, design decisions, limitations, validation evidence, data contracts, workflows, and compliance touchpoints; provide technical leadership through reviews, mentoring, and cross\-team handoffs. **Required Competencies** * Strong Python software engineering skills and experience building APIs, data services, and AI/ML applications using frameworks such as FastAPI, PyTorch, LangChain, or LangGraph. * Hands\-on experience building or integrating LLM\-based systems using commercial or open\-source models and applying prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, and model orchestration. * Practical knowledge of RAG architecture, embedding models, vector databases, semantic search, and techniques for evaluating retrieval and generation quality. * Demonstrated ability to assess AI\-assisted outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and fitness for use rather than relying on generated results at face value. * Experience designing reliable production systems with automated testing, version control, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, containerization, and secure deployment across Azure, edge, or hybrid environments. * Ability to understand process, manufacturing, or other operational workflows and convert them into clear data, software, and AI requirements. * Sound technical judgment, curiosity, and resourcefulness when working through open\-ended problems, incomplete information, and competing design options; ability to explain tradeoffs and risks to engineering and operational audiences. * Ability to work independently, collaborate across disciplines, manage priorities, and maintain attention to detail while supporting customer outcomes, responsible AI practices, and continuous learning. * Required Education \& Experience * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Five or more years of professional experience in AI/ML, software engineering, data science, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of production solutions. * Experience taking at least one AI or ML capability from problem definition through deployment, validation, monitoring, and operational support. * Experience working within software delivery practices that include Git, code review, automated testing, and agile or flow\-based execution. **Preferred Experience/Competencies** * Experience with industrial data and controls, including OPC UA, MQTT/Sparkplug B, SCADA/DCS, PLCs, industrial historians, Unified Namespace patterns, or ISA\-95/ISA\-88 contextualization. * Experience with Azure data services such as Event Hubs, Azure Data Explorer/KQL, Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Structured Streaming, or ADLS Gen2\. * Experience designing schema\-versioned data contracts, validation pipelines, time\-series data products, or lakehouse medallion architectures. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), governed agent tool design, multi\-agent orchestration, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Domain exposure in power generation, life sciences, batch manufacturing, or another regulated process industry, including reliability, maintenance, optimization, or operational analytics use cases. * Experience with architecture decision records, technical standards, and cross\-team contract\-based delivery. **Physical Requirements** * Standing * Walking * Sitting * Kneeling * Reaching Overhead * Climbing * Pushing and Pulling * Lifting \- 50 pounds * Using a Computer * Using a Telephone * Driving *Apperture Solutions is a federal contractor and, as such, is required to solicit the disability status and protected veteran status of candidates. Thus, you are required to answer self\-identification questions as part of your application process. These questions are part of Apperture Solution's Affirmative Action Plan and the completion of these questions will not have any effect on any consideration of your application materials.* ***In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA)****, if you have a disability and need to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with Apperture Solutions, please call our office at (704\) 375\-4465\.* *This is a drug\-free workplace. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of any required pre\-employment and, if applicable, ongoing drug testing, including testing mandated by customer site access requirements.*

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About Prudentia Sciences** ---------------------------- Prudentia Sciences is an AI\-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by: * **Empowering biopharma** to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact * **Enabling strategic positioning** of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking * **Equipping investors** with data\-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, SignalFire, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R\&D by empowering decision\-makers with real\-time, data\-driven insights. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We’re looking for a driven, hands\-on Senior ML/AI Engineer to help us push the boundaries of what's possible in AI\-driven drug development. You’ll work on production\-grade LLM\-based systems, knowledge graphs, and machine learning pipelines—turning prototypes into powerful tools that make a real\-world impact. You'll collaborate across teams to design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that enhance how life sciences organizations make critical decisions. If you love working on technically challenging problems with direct impact in healthcare—this is the role for you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Design and Deploy LLM Systems:** Develop scalable, production\-ready LLM applications using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph. Build robust RAG pipelines and integrate knowledge graphs for biological and clinical data. * **Full\-Stack AI Engineering:** Write maintainable, high\-performance code and build clean APIs and services for machine learning applications. * **Data Engineering Collaboration:** Work with data engineers to build and optimize data workflows and pipelines for high\-quality data ingestion and processing. * **Product\-Focused Prototyping:** Collaborate with product and domain teams to rapidly prototype AI solutions, iterate based on feedback, and scale models for production. * **Model Deployment \& MLOps:** Use modern MLOps tools to deploy and monitor models in production environments (AWS preferred). Ensure scalability, observability, and resilience. * **Collaborative Innovation:** Partner with engineering, data, and business teams to identify and develop high\-value AI/ML applications. * **Continuous Learning:** Stay ahead of the curve on emerging ML frameworks, GenAI capabilities, and healthcare technologies. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- **Core Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor's, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. * **Hands\-on AI Experience:** Proven ability to build, train, and deploy ML and NLP models, especially those powered by LLMs and transformer architectures. * **LLM \& LangChain Experience**: Practical experience working with frameworks like LangChain for applications such as Q\&A systems, chatbots, or document automation. * **Software Engineering:** Strong coding skills in Python and experience using Git/GitHub and CI/CD practices. * **Data Engineering Know\-how:** Comfort working with ETL pipelines, relational and non\-relational databases, and data platforms like Snowflake or Databricks. * **Big Data \& ML Frameworks:** Familiarity with Big Data tools (e.g., Apache Spark) and experience orchestrating data workflows using tools like Apache Airflow. * **Cloud \& MLOps:** Experience with deploying ML models in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and using containerization/orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. **Soft Skills:** * Strong problem\-solving skills and an analytical mindset. * Passion for continuous learning, rapid prototyping, and iterating based on user needs. * Autonomous, self\-starter attitude with a strong sense of ownership. * Excellent communication skills—able to explain technical ideas clearly to non\-technical audiences. * Collaborative team player with a desire to build things that truly matter. **Bonus:** * Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or biopharma sectors (preferred but not required). **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Make a tangible impact on drug development and patient outcomes. * Work with a passionate, mission\-driven team tackling complex challenges. * Enjoy flexibility and autonomy in a remote\-first culture. * Competitive salary, equity, and benefits. * Opportunity to grow with a fast\-moving, well\-funded startup backed by top\-tier investors. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Impact: Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster * Ownership: Build and lead the customer success function as a foundational leader * Growth: Shape customer experience during a critical scaling phase * Compensation: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity * Team: Collaborative, mission\-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma **Location** ------------ We are open to exceptional talent that is fully remote in the U.S. but have strong preference towards someone who can come in our Boston, San Francisco or New York City office twice per week (Tues/Thurs). Compensation Range: $206K \- $240K

jobs.title: Senior Operations Site Leader
jobs.description: Description: JOB SUMMARY The Senior Operations Site Leader is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, compliance, and strategic execution of the manufacturing site. This role provides direction across all site operations, including Manufacturing, Engineering/Maintenance, Planning, Shipping, Warehousing, and EHS, to ensure safe, compliant, efficient, and high\-performing site operations. The Senior Operations Site Leader serves as the senior leader for the location and is accountable for achieving site goals related to safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, employee engagement, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement. This position partners closely with functional, corporate and commercial leaders to align site execution with business priorities, customer expectations, and long\-term operational strategy. Procurement and sourcing remain globally managed under the Global Supply Chain and Procurement Director. Strong leadership in a matrixed organization and across all levels of the business and all functions will be essential to drive the Treatt culture forward. DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES The duties and tasks of the Senior Operations Site Leader will involve the following: Site Leadership and Strategy * Lead the overall site strategy and execution plan to support business objectives, operational performance, customer requirements and growth priorities * Provide leadership and direction to site department heads, including Plant Management, Manufacturing, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering/Maintenance, Planning, Shipping and Warehousing, EHS and Continuous Improvement * Ensure strong alignment across functions so that site priorities are clear, resources are effectively deployed and decisions support safety, quality, service and cost objectives * Serve as the senior site representative and primary point of accountability for site performance, culture, communication and execution * Drive standardization of business processes across the site, aligned with the wider Döhler Group * Support the SAP roll\-out for the site, driving readiness and adoption across all site functions * Lead effectively within a matrixed organization to execute on milestones and move Treatt North America forward to increased success Operational Performance * Oversee site operations to ensure achievement of production, service, quality, safety, cost and productivity goals * Partner with the Plant Manager and operational leaders to identify performance gaps, resolve issues and implement sustainable improvements * Monitor key performance indicators and use data to drive decision\-making and accountability, taking counter actions to bring performance back on track * Ensure effective planning and execution of production schedules, capacity planning, labor utilization, material flow and operational readiness Engineering, Maintenance and Asset Reliability * Provide leadership and direction to Engineering and Maintenance, ensuring asset reliability, equipment uptime, preventive maintenance and technical support meet site performance requirements * Own the site capital plan end to end, from identifying and justifying investment through approval, execution and post\-implementation review, ensuring projects deliver the expected operational and financial return * Apply sound technical and engineering judgment to process improvement, debottlenecking, capacity expansion, automation and the introduction of new equipment or processes * Ensure engineering standards, process safety requirements and management of change are applied consistently to all site projects, modifications and new installations * Balance short\-term production demands against long\-term asset health, ensuring maintenance and reliability are not deferred in ways that create future risk Safety, Health and Environment * Drive a continuously improving, safety\-first culture so all our employees go home safely every day, with accountability for the HSE performance of the site * Hold leaders accountable for safe work practices, risk reduction, incident prevention and timely corrective action * Partner with EHS leadership to strengthen programs, improve safety performance and build employee ownership of safety expectations Quality, Regulatory and Compliance * Ensure the site operates in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, customer standards, company policies, food safety requirements, quality systems and audit expectations * Support a strong quality and compliance culture, ensuring that production goals do not compromise product quality, regulatory obligations or customer trust * Partner with Quality and Regulatory leaders to maintain inspection readiness, address audit findings and drive corrective and preventive actions * Ensure work is performed in accordance with appropriate Standard Operating Procedures, policies and practices Planning and Warehousing * Lead site planning, shipping and warehousing to ensure effective scheduling, inventory manag ing, with a ‘fail fast, learn fast’ mentality * Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, employee relations, training and change management * Communicate clearly and consistently with employees at all levels to reinforce priorities, expectations, progress and business context * Act in the best interests of the Treatt Group at all times Success Measures * Safety performance and risk reduction * Quality and regulatory compliance * Delivery performance, including OTIF and schedule attainment * Cost, productivity and budget performance * Employee engagement and leadership capability * Continuous improvement results, audit performance and inspection readiness Requirements: EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Process or Industrial) or a related technical field required, reflecting the process manufacturing environment. MBA or advanced degree preferred * Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations management experience in flavors, food ingredients or closely related regulated manufacturing environments * Minimum of 5 years of people leadership experience, including leadership of managers or cross\-functional teams * Demonstrated experience leading site operations, plant performance, safety, quality, service, cost and continuous improvement initiatives * Experience managing budgets, capital projects, cost improvement initiatives and operational performance metrics * Technical or engineering grounding in a process manufacturing environment, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers and technical specialists on equipment, process design, reliability and capital investment decisions * Experience overseeing an engineering or maintenance function, including preventive maintenance programs, asset reliability and plant capital planning * Experience working in a global organization or matrixed reporting environment preferred * GMP, Six Sigma and 5S implementation expertise required; formal Lean or Six Sigma certification preferred * Advanced SAP or (ERP) user; experience contributing to or leading SAP or (ERP) rollouts strongly preferred SKILLS \& ABILITIES * Can do attitude, focused on delivery not title * Strong organizational skills, with the ability to plan and deliver multiple projects to clearly defined deadlines * Entrepreneurial vision – a self\-starter with a hands\-on approach * Ability to lead and influence a culturally diverse team * Strong operational focus and strategic vision to see the wider picture * Great interpersonal and relationship skills with the ability to lead, manage, motivate and influence teams and colleagues * Solid working knowledge of budgeting, operations, supply chain and strategic planning * Excellent understanding of financial data * Strong planning skills across production scheduling, capacity and materials management * Highly analytical, with strong communication skills to translate data into clear priorities and actions * Strong understanding of regulated manufacturing environments, quality systems, food safety and GMP requirements, EHS expectations and operational controls * Technical fluency in process manufacturing, with the ability to interpret process and reliability data, understand the unit operations and equipment that drive site performance and constructively challenge engineering and maintenance decisions * Strong problem\-solving and change management skills * Capable of difficult decision making – utilizing all the appropriate information required, and sharing views with key stakeholders WORKING CONDITIONS * Environment: Fully on\-site leadership role based at the Lakeland facility, with no home office arrangement. Office, lab and manufacturing environment, including shop floor exposure inside and outside production areas; potential exposure to hazardous chemicals * Physical Factors: Sitting, walking, standing * Travel: Occasional domestic travel with periodic overseas travel to the UK.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Entry Level (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: **Why Gravitate?** At Gravitate, we’re on a mission to reinvent how refiners and gas stations buy, sell, and transport fuel. We are proud to serve this massive industry that touches nearly everyone’s daily life. Our AI\-powered technology suite is already delivering huge value for some of the world’s largest fuel companies, and we’re just getting started. We’re growing fast, and we want ambitious engineers and problem\-solvers to join us for the next wave of innovation. At Gravitate, you’ll work with modern tech, learn from experienced mentors, and see your ideas make an impact right away. Our culture is built on high performance and high positivity. We believe winning is a team sport — we share knowledge freely, support each other, and celebrate every win together. We’re obsessed with finding better ways to solve tough problems, and we know the next big idea can come from anyone, including you. If you’re a self\-starter, a natural leader, and someone who truly cares about the work you do, you’ll fit right in at Gravitate. #### **About the Role:** We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Software Engineer (Entry Level) to join our growing technology team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their career who is passionate about building software solutions that solve real\-world problems. You’ll work closely with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and maintain our suite of applications across a variety of platforms. #### **Responsibilities:** * Own well\-defined tasks within your team’s product area, working closely with senior engineers on larger projects. * Deliver reliably against sprint commitments; flag risks as soon as you see them. * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation while building a working understanding of monitoring and observability. * Participate in code reviews, taking direct feedback and acting on it while contributing to team knowledge sharing. * Develop working knowledge of the fuel supply and logistics industry as it applies to your team’s product area. * Follow the team’s established design patterns and conventions, and be able to explain design decisions in review. * Write clean, tested code, taking ownership of the implementation, automated testing, and validation over the quality of your work. * Communicate early and often, focusing on learning and providing feedback to your team. #### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience. * Internship, co\-op or professional experience in a software development organization * Solid understanding of software development fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures. * Familiarity with web development technologies, APIs, databases, and version control systems like Git. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages; **preference given to candidates with experience in our stack (Python, .NET (C\#), Typescript, React)**. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies. #### **Nice to Have (but not required):** * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). * Experience with CI/CD systems like Github Actions. * Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. #### **Why Join Us?** At Gravitate, people are not replaceable parts—they are the heart of our success. We believe in open communication, teamwork, and clapping for each other at every opportunity. Our culture emphasizes growth, collaboration, and creating lasting careers. Problem solvers, go\-getters, and charge\-takers — we (really) want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern

Our platform helps fabs improve yield, predict process issues, and accelerate root\-cause analysis. We are building a lean U.S. hub in Menlo Park to support global semiconductor customers and develop young AI/software talent. Role Overview * Build agents and LLM\-powered tools — tool calling, retrieval, planning loops, structured outputs * Design the evaluations that tell you whether the system actually works, not just whether it ran * Explore and clean real customer data: undocumented columns, missing values, sensor noise * Build and test models on process data — and be honest about what the numbers mean * Turn prototypes into things your teammates can run, with documentation that holds up * Present a weekly demo: what you built, what broke, what you learned Qualifications * Current student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Physics or a related field * Strong Python — comfortable with pandas and NumPy, and comfortable reading code you didn't write * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs: API calls, prompting, tool use, retrieval, or agent loops. electrical, mechanical, systems, RF, and other engineers to understand system requirements and support integrated development. * Research new software technologies, libraries, frameworks, development tools, and engineering approaches applicable to current projects. * Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including software requirements, architecture and design documentation, test procedures, development notes, and engineering reports. * Learn and apply good software engineering practices related to maintainability, modularity, reliability, cybersecurity, configuration management, and reproducibility. **Qualifications:** ------------------- * Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as C, C\+\+, or Python. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Understanding of fundamental software development principles and practices. * Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Coursework or project experience using Python, C, C\+\+, Java, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another programming language. * Familiarity with Git or another version control system through coursework, personal projects, or collaborative development. * Experience using Linux, the command line, or a Unix\-like development environment. * Exposure to software testing concepts such as unit testing, automated testing, debugging, or test\-driven development. * Familiarity with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, cloud computing, or similar technologies. * Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, or software deployment concepts. * Experience developing software that communicates with hardware, sensors, microcontrollers, embedded systems, networks, APIs, or other software services. * Familiarity with data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented programming, software architecture, networking, operating systems, databases, or other core computer science concepts. * Experience working on a collaborative technical project using tools for source control, issue tracking, documentation, or project management. * Personal software projects, GitHub repositories, hackathon projects, engineering club participation, undergraduate research, robotics projects, or other hands\-on technical work. * Interest in aerospace, defense, embedded systems, artificial intelligence and machine learning, RF systems, distributed systems, DevOps, cybersecurity, or other mission\-oriented engineering technologies.
