typically five or more years for this level. * Strong Java experience and experience designing maintainable REST APIs and backend services. * Strong TypeScript and modern frontend development experience using a component\-based framework. * Experience building data\-rich user interfaces and visualizations, including transforming complex data into clear customer\-facing insights. * A solid understanding of API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and asynchronous workflows. * Experience with automated testing, Git\-based development, code review, and iterative product delivery. * Experience working with persistent data stores such as MongoDB or relational databases, and with search or analytics technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants as part of an engineering workflow, combined with the judgment to review and improve their output. * Clear communication, collaborative problem\-solving, and the ability to take an ambiguous problem through to production. **Desired Skills** ================== You do not need to match every item. We would be especially interested in experience with: * Angular or another modern component\-based frontend framework. * Asynchronous and non\-blocking Java development using Vert.x, RxJava, Netty, or comparable reactive technologies. * Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native application delivery. * API management, API gateways, OpenAPI, or event\-streaming platforms such as Kafka. * API security and identity standards such as OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect. * Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent2Agent (A2A), tool calling, LLM proxies, or other emerging AI protocols and standards. Prior production experience is not required. * Building or operating LLM\-powered applications, RAG systems, or agentic workflows \- especially their security, governance, and observability needs. * Open\-source software or enterprise developer platforms. **Who Thrives at Gravitee** =========================== Our growth is powered by people who bring passion to what they build, professionalism to how they work, and a commitment to doing things well. You will thrive here if you: * Bring energy and a constructive attitude to the team. * Adapt quickly and enjoy learning unfamiliar technologies and domains. * Take ownership, communicate clearly, and follow through with urgency. * Balance delivery speed with thoughtful engineering judgment. * Start with the customer problem and care about the quality of the experience you create. * Enjoy working in a fast\-moving, collaborative, international environment. **Life at Gravitee** ==================== At Gravitee, we invest in humans, not just roles. You’ll get: * Salary of $160,000 * Competitive medical coverage. * Pension / 401(k) program options. * Stock options \- you build it, you own it. * 25 days of holiday plus in\-country national holidays. * Three mental health days and a wellness allowance. * Your birthday off. * A professional development budget to support your growth. * A hybrid work culture with hubs across regions. * Quarterly team events and an annual company offsite. * A collaborative, international company culture. * Opportunities to grow your scope and career as Gravitee grows. At Gravitee, we believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams. No employee or applicant will be treated less favorably on the grounds of sex, marital status, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, religion, or belief. Our technology helps the world’s biggest construction projects make faster, more confident, data\-driven decisions.** **By combining one of the world’s largest datasets of project plans with advanced machine learning, we forecast project outcomes and reduce risk — reshaping how infrastructure gets built.** ### **The Role** **We are looking for a Principal Client Engineer with deep expertise in project controls, risk analysis and complex construction schedules of major projects to join and help shape our growing client team. from day one, and you'll be working with talented people who care deeply about our mission.** **While you work remotely, you will also attend monthly client visits and team meetings in our London office as well as have the opportunity to visit our international clients.** **About The Role** **You'll work cross\-functionally across multiple areas, using your domain expertise and seniority to the value they get from nPlan.** * **Owning and growing our most complex or highest\-value client relationships, and acting as an escalation point across the wider client portfolio when things get **Product deployment** * **Owning strategic projects end\-to\-end that improve how we embed our products within client organisations, including projects that span multiple clients or accounts.** * **Setting the approach for how clients adopt our advanced features (e.g. LLM\-based features), and mentoring clients directly on the most complex use cases.** **Commercial** * **Partnering with Commercial leadership to shape strategy for engagement, retention, and expansion, not just executing on it.** **Product** * **Acting as a senior domain\-expert voice with Product Managers and AI Engineers, shaping prototyping direction rather than just contributing to it.** * **Owning the domain\-expert function within our LLM evaluation cycle, setting the standard for what "reliable and accurate" means and improving the process itself.** **What We're Looking For** **We're excited to hear from people who bring expertise, authority, and curiosity.** **To succeed in this role, you'll bring:** * **7\+ years of experience in a planning, risk, PMO, or project management role on major construction projects, including a track record of owning the trickiest schedule risk problems end\-to\-end.** * **Deep understanding of large construction schedules (P6\), how they are built, and how to analyse them.** * **Demonstrable experience leading and delivering strategic projects that significantly improve an important outcome for an organisation, with the credibility to influence senior client stakeholders directly.** * **Experience mentoring or upskilling other planning, risk or project controls professionals.** * **Passion for implementing technology to improve the construction industry.** * **Attention to detail \- please mention the word 'crane' in your application form.** * **Excellent relationship\-building skills: You care deeply about delighting customers.** **Nice to haves:** * **Experience working in a software company or on the implementation of software in the construction context** * **Experience working with LLM applications** * **Experience shaping how a team's methodology or ways of working evolve, or feeding client insight back into product direction** ### **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **Competitive salary between $110k \- $140k \+ generous equity — when nPlan succeeds, so do you.** * **Flexible hours, remote\-friendly, with a Shoreditch office HQ.** * **Uncapped holiday, private medical insurance, personal learning and development budget, enhanced family and sick leave, and more.** * **Room to grow — we’re just over 50 people and scaling fast.** * **Guided by our values: Learn from Everything. jobs.title: Head of Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote: United States **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- FinanceFinanceBusiness Operations **Compensation** ---------------- * $222K – $272K • Offers Equity *Our openings span more than one career level. The provided salary depends on many factors, such as work experience and transferable skills, business needs and impact, location, and market demands.* At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ The Head of Strategic Partnerships \& Ecosystem will manage and grow Render's most critical technology partner relationships. This role involves building and executing a comprehensive partnerships strategy — spanning AI ecosystem integrations, hyperscalers and early bets on emerging platforms — that drives meaningful distribution and growth for Render. These partnerships touch nearly every part of Render — Product, Engineering, DevRel, and Business Development — and often involve senior stakeholders at some of the largest and fastest\-moving companies in AI, so doing this well means coordinating closely across those internal teams and keeping Render's leadership regularly informed. The ideal candidate brings real technical depth in AI and developer tooling, paired with a proven background in partner management, strong relationship\-building instincts, and the executive presence to engage with partner leadership at the highest levels. You should have a deep understanding of how to build and scale product\-centric partnerships — from ecosystem integrations to platform\-level bets — in a fast\-moving, technical market. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Map Render's technology partnership landscape across AI labs, hyperscalers, and emerging developer products, and build the strategy for where Render has the strongest right to win. * Own outcomes for the partnerships portfolio — set clear milestones, timelines, and success metrics (e.g., ecosystem integration, developer adoption, joint launches, revenue impact) and hold yourself accountable to them. * Drive day\-to\-day partnership strategy and execution, taking deals from evaluation through negotiation, launch, and renewal, including commercial terms. * Partner closely with Product, DevRel, and Product Marketing to secure roadmap and staffing commitments, drive integration execution, and run co\-marketing — and work with Finance and Legal to structure and manage commercial agreements. * Scope and lead our thinking on building out a Render Marketplace — including the value proposition to customers and key partners, product and engineering requirements, and commercial and financial terms. * Own ongoing relationship management for key partners — acting as their primar siness reviews and planning sessions, driving expansion and renewal over time, and serving as their internal advocate at Render. * Bring operating rigor to the program: track and report on partnership performance, maintain clear documentation, and keep leadership updated on progress and upcoming launches. * Build out a team of partner managers as we scale. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 6–10\+ years of experience in strategic or technical partnerships, business development, or product\-facing roles at technology companies — ideally where partnerships were critical during a period of hypergrowth. * A highly technical background is strongly preferred — former PM, forward\-deployed engineer, or engineering experience, particularly within AI — so you can go deep with partner engineering and product teams on integration architecture, connectors, and protocols. * Demonstrated success managing and growing complex, high\-impact partnerships across AI, cloud, or developer platform ecosystems. * Strong cross\-functional operating skills, with experience working alongside Product, Engineering, DevRel, Legal, and Finance to execute complex initiatives. * Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to use data to drive strategic decisions. * Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to engage at the executive level. * Strong bias for action — comfortable operating both independently and as part of cross\-functional teams, in a fast\-moving environment with evolving priorities. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Hands\-on experience with MCP, plugins, connectors, or app/marketplace ecosystems specifically. * Deep familiarity with the developer tools and infrastructure landscape, and a point of view on how emerging AI\-native companies find distribution. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return. * Long\-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans. * 100% employer\-paid medical coverage and 99% employer\-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.* *Render is an equal\-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.* *We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.* *We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!* Render — CCPA Applicant Privacy Notice Render — GDPR Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $222K \- $272K
